answer: The proof is verified against the universal SRS, and the index is checked before verification. A farm needs 124 separate Marlin proofs, since each one is bound to its own index and inputs. Marlin proves indexed R1CS against a universal structured reference string, so no per-circuit setup is needed. Watch the shale: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the nectar bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the vine audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
